# Nerd Utility API

> Fast, free micro-service API for AI agents and developers. No auth, no keys.
> Base URL: see PUBLIC_URL.md (public tunnel URL, may rotate).

## Endpoints (all accept GET or POST, JSON responses)

- /format — pretty-print / minify JSON
- /csv2json, /json2csv — data conversion
- /base64 — encode/decode
- /hash — md5, sha1, sha256, sha512
- /uuid — UUID v4 generation
- /timestamp — unix <-> ISO conversion
- /text-stats — word/char counts
- /qrcode — QR code PNG generation
- /dns — DNS lookups (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME)
- /headers — echo request headers
- /ipinfo — client IP geolocation
- /scrape — fetch and extract text from a URL
- /price — crypto price (BTC, ETH, ...) via public feed
- /price/history — price history
- /alerts — price watchdog rules (GET/POST/DELETE)
- /random — random number in range
- /password — strong password generator
- /lorem — lorem ipsum generator
- /slugify — URL slug from text
- /case — upper/lower/title case
- /url-encode — percent encode/decode
- /docs — human-readable docs
- /openapi.json — full OpenAPI 3.0 spec
- /stats — usage analytics
- /health — liveness probe

## Machine-readable

- OpenAPI 3.0: {BASE_URL}/openapi.json
- MCP server available: mcp-server.js (stdio, 26 tools)

## Pricing

All endpoints are currently free. No payment required.
